dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent, sharp white boundaries forming high grayscale contrast against the dark brown/grey primary and secondary feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible but soft transition from more uniform brownish crown pixels to the high-contrast scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely distinct white scalloping/fringing across the entire visible dorsal plumage.
